title: Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Late Fee Share by Project Size
content:
**Pricing schedule.** For a late fee on a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing account whose plan carries no promotion (a fixed-rate or low-payment plan), the share of the scheduled payment follows the size of the project the account finances, read from the signed contract price of the window or door contract it funds: a contract price at or above the schedule's large-project price of 30000.00 takes the large-project share of 3.5%; a contract price below the schedule's small-project price of 15000.00 takes the small-project share of 8%; any other contract price takes the plan's stated share.

The contract price is the signed contract price recorded on the Window Replacement Contracts contract, or on the Entry & Patio Door Contracts contract, that the financing account funds. The plan's stated share is the plan's late-fee percentage limit.

## Share by contract price

| Signed contract price of the financed contract | Share of the scheduled payment |
|---|---|
| 30000.00 or more | 3.5% |
| 15000.00 or more, but below 30000.00 | The plan's stated share |
| Below 15000.00 | 8% |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical contract prices)

| Contract price | Share |
|---|---|
| 30000.00 | 3.5% (at the large-project price) |
| 29999.99 | The plan's stated share |
| 15000.00 | The plan's stated share (not below the small-project price) |
| 14999.99 | 8% |

The share applies to the scheduled payment of the period, and the share figure is that share times the scheduled payment, rounded to the cent.
